s.note: the cooler he uses to carry home his treasures
s.how: Cut the top off a 20cm round cob loaf and pull out most of the soft inside. Spread the inside with 4 tbsp basil pesto. Layer in 150g leg ham, 150g roasted capsicum, 150g sliced mozzarella, a handful of baby spinach, 100g salami and 100g semi-dried tomatoes, pressing each layer down. Replace the lid, wrap tightly in plastic wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight. Cut into wedges.

s.note: the cubes of compacted rubbish he stacks into towers
s.how: Melt 60g butter with 250g marshmallows over low heat. Stir through 150g puffed rice until coated. Press into a lined tray and set for an hour. Cut into neat cubes and stack them into towers.

m.note: the cruise ship where everyone drinks their meals
m.how: Soften an onion with 1 tbsp grated ginger. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 150g red lentils, 400ml coconut milk and 600ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blitz. Serve in big mugs with a straw, and grilled cheese made from 8 slices sourdough and 150g cheddar on the side.

w.note: the little sponge cake he finds in the rubbish
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar until pale and thick, then fold in 100g flour. Pipe 12 fingers onto a lined tray and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool, split and pipe in 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.note: the floating chairs and endless drinks on the cruise ship
d.how: Blend 150g frozen raspberries, the juice of 4 lemons, 80ml blue raspberry cordial, 3 tbsp caster sugar, 300ml cold water and 4 cups ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into tall cups and serve straight away with a straw and a lemon wheel.
